From c8e2d4873902c58ee14d3eb5138f516ba963e7d9 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Dan Carpenter <dan.carpenter@linaro.org>
Date: Thu, 4 Apr 2024 10:31:25 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] iio: light: apds9306: Fix off by one in
 apds9306_sampling_freq_get()

The > comparison needs to be >= to prevent an out of bounds access.

Fixes: 620d1e6c7a3f ("iio: light: Add support for APDS9306 Light Sensor")
Signed-off-by: Dan Carpenter <dan.carpenter@linaro.org>
Reviewed-by: Subhajit Ghosh <subhajit.ghosh@tweaklogic.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/69c5cb83-0209-40ff-a276-a0ae5e81c528@moroto.mountain
Signed-off-by: Jonathan Cameron <Jonathan.Cameron@huawei.com>

diff --git a/drivers/iio/light/apds9306.c b/drivers/iio/light/apds9306.c
index 4d8490602cd7..49fa6b7d5170 100644
--- a/drivers/iio/light/apds9306.c
+++ b/drivers/iio/light/apds9306.c
@@ -635,7 +635,7 @@ static int apds9306_sampling_freq_get(struct apds9306_data *data, int *val,
 	if (ret)
 		return ret;
 
-	if (repeat_rate_idx > ARRAY_SIZE(apds9306_repeat_rate_freq))
+	if (repeat_rate_idx >= ARRAY_SIZE(apds9306_repeat_rate_freq))
 		return -EINVAL;
 
 	*val = apds9306_repeat_rate_freq[repeat_rate_idx][0];
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/iio/light/apds9306.c`**
   - The condition in the `apds9306_sampling_freq_get` function was modified from:
     ```c
     if (repeat_rate_idx > ARRAY_SIZE(apds9306_repeat_rate_freq))
     ```
     to:
     ```c
     if (repeat_rate_idx >= ARRAY_SIZE(apds9306_repeat_rate_freq))
     ```
   - This change ensures that the comparison correctly checks for an out-of-bounds access by using `>=` instead of `>`.

### Relationships

- The modification in `apds9306.c` addresses a bug related to an out-of-bounds access that could occur when the `repeat_rate_idx` is equal to the size of the `apds9306_repeat_rate_freq` array. The fix is directly linked to the previous commit identified by the hash `620d1e6c7a3f`, which added support for the APDS9306 Light Sensor. The change improves the robustness of the code by preventing potential errors that could arise from incorrect index handling.

Here is the commit message:
iio: light: apds9306: Fix off by one in
 apds9306_sampling_freq_get()

The > comparison needs to be >= to prevent an out of bounds access.

Fixes: 620d1e6c7a3f ("iio: light: Add support for APDS9306 Light Sensor")
Signed-off-by: Dan Carpenter <dan.carpenter@linaro.org>
Reviewed-by: Subhajit Ghosh <subhajit.ghosh@tweaklogic.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/69c5cb83-0209-40ff-a276-a0ae5e81c528@moroto.mountain
Signed-off-by: Jonathan Cameron <Jonathan.Cameron@huawei.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by an incorrect comparison operator in the condition that checks the validity of the `repeat_rate_idx` index. Using `>` instead of `>=` allowed the index to potentially equal the size of the `apds9306_repeat_rate_freq` array, leading to an out-of-bounds access when attempting to access an element at that index.

Here is the patch:
 
 static int apds9306_sampling_freq_get(struct apds9306_data *data, int *val,
 				      int *val2)
 {
 	struct apds9306_regfields *rf = &data->rf;
 	int ret, repeat_rate_idx;
 
 	ret = regmap_field_read(rf->repeat_rate, &repeat_rate_idx);
 	if (ret)
 		return ret;
 
-	if (repeat_rate_idx > ARRAY_SIZE(apds9306_repeat_rate_freq))
+	if (repeat_rate_idx >= ARRAY_SIZE(apds9306_repeat_rate_freq))
 		return -EINVAL;
 
 	*val = apds9306_repeat_rate_freq[repeat_rate_idx][0];
 	*val2 = apds9306_repeat_rate_freq[repeat_rate_idx][1];
 
 	return 0;
 }

Reason:
